entry.title: Beaumaris Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture confirms roofless concentric wards, six squat inner towers, twin-D gatehouses, lower outer circuit and partial moat. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained outline set approximate location, scale and sea-gate/dock orientation. A reconstructed1.6m working rise clears coarse ground around the castle; bounded wall/tower bottoms extend beneath sampled terrain. Moat/dock blue surfaces remain an approximate visual interpretation, with no terrain cutout or water simulation. Anchor -4.089706701,53.26470434; heading 0.26314714676; standard PMTiles datum 7.4077225530211805m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
